message:
Good, clang 18 is available. Let me build the fuzzer with ASAN. I'll use the oss-fuzz build script approach but with a standalone fuzzing engine. Let me build libxml2 with ASAN and then compile the fuzzer:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && export CC=clang CXX=clang++ && export CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer" && export CXXFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer" && ./autogen.sh --disable-shared --without-debug --without-http --without-python --without-zlib --without-lzma 2>&1 | tail -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
